# P08 · Answer-sheet capture (both channels) and data import: v3 carry-over items

Created 2026-10-19 by the kit v3 migration (`docs/build/reports/MIGRATION-v1-v3.md`). Step B of the protocol merges these into the phase's full task list.

## v3 carry-over (added 2026-10-19, from `docs/build/reports/MIGRATION-v1-v3.md`)

- [ ] Check flow `services/api/flows/check.py`, one definition for both channels (photo_batch in roll order, running count, Done); Telegram deletes each photo message once read (verify the Bot API; otherwise ask her to clear and say so in `docs/privacy.md`); PWA deletes outbox copies after confirmation.
- [ ] Per-sheet reads in server memory only, keyed by sequence number, 30-minute TTL; never disk, database, logs or traces. Test first: temp-file and log assertions; TTL expiry.
- [ ] Confirm step as a `choice` with an in-memory crop; typed fallback as a `number_grid`; T3 emitted as message steps with counts and no percentage.
- [ ] Golden transcripts: late, duplicate and out-of-order photo; a retake; "Done" with a sheet missing; the PWA outbox replaying after reconnect.
- [ ] `docs/privacy.md` (photo and read lifecycle in each channel); remove the v1 on-device `checks` once this works (see P05 V3-T08).

- [ ] v3 acceptance: on a real phone, a 10-sheet check runs end to end in the bot and in the PWA, including one confirm, ending in T3 with counts; photos taken offline go through on reconnect in both (human confirms).
- [ ] Verify against the Telegram docs before coding: the photo sizes offered for download, whether bots can delete incoming messages in private chats and any time limit.
- [ ] State importer, `pilot_import`, eval 9: renumbered in v3, unchanged.
- [ ] `docs/privacy.md`: the photo and read lifecycle per channel, the voice-upload note (Starlette may spool an upload above 1 MB to a temporary file; it is the teacher's own audio and is deleted on close), record-mode fixtures, and the full table list in `docs/architecture.md` (add `profile_sync`, `speech_calls`, `classroom`, `class_term_count`).
